name: Biosites

sources.title: Bio Sites homepage - Squarespace's free link-in-bio tool
Bio Sites - signup (redirects into the /editor app)
Bio Sites - editor / create a free Bio Site

requirements: Not a directory: biosites.com is Squarespace's 'Bio Sites' link-in-bio product - 'Create a free Bio Site' gives a public bio.site/<yourname> page
A free account is created inside the /editor app (signup URL forwards there)
Aimed at creators/brands for Instagram/TikTok/YouTube link-in-bio use - selling, tips, and email capture are built in
preparation: Brand assets: template pick, layout, fonts, colors
Links to feature (product URL, socials); optional Stripe/PayPal if monetization features are wanted
workflow: Create a free account and pick a template
Add links/content in the drag-and-drop editor and publish
The public bio.site page is the deliverable - there is no directory listing to wait for
watchFor: Expectation mismatch: this produces a hosted link-in-bio page, not a dofollow directory listing - the SEO value is the bio.site page itself linking out
Monetization features (Stripe/PayPal, affiliates, tips) are optional - core page is free
Owned by Squarespace/Unfold; help routes to help.unfold.com
Signup page is a JS app - empty render on text-only fetch
countsAsLive: A public page at bio.site/<handle> resolves and shows your links
unknowns: Whether bio.site pages pass any link equity to the target site
Whether any paid tier gates features (none advertised on the homepage - 'free' is the pitch)
